messages.content_text:
DAY 25  : 6 TRADES  1 BE 5 L'S (EVALS)

TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
I marked out direction of price and it went exactly where i wanted it to go. So from tapping the 1H RB, we were on our way down. Found a silver bullet entry, entered with tight stop, price ran perfectly down but also immediately before hitting my tp, reversed and stopped me at BE. and then moved its way down to hit TP. Everything from my top down analysis and execution was A+. not to mention we had htf smt and ltf smt. Price just had other plans. as far as what i could've done, was use the volume profile to locate POI nodes to set more specific TP's. I went for value area low, instead of POI. 

Every one of the rest of the trades was getting caught in the consolidation, thinking it was a reversal. Biggest tell was the decorrelation. there was never a clear pd array on both. keep that in mind. acknowledge the 4H candle PO3. it was a bit hard to know but with the context of the rest of the chart, it should be clear that it was po3 up and down to continuation. that may be the strongest confluence you have now. 

PSYCHOLOGICAL ANALYSIS
Fell victim to my own ego today. Told myself that i was done and we another 4 trades. I now remember why i dont break rules. I shouldn't be breaking rules just because of an eval. I should treat it just like a regular account. Otherwise the discipline wont be built. This was the biggest thing. I could have just walked away with -200 on the day but now it's -700. And obviously every time i got more and more tilted. i think it's cause i was very pnl focused today. and that misguided me to make bad decisions in my trading. There was the thought of only wanting to end positive today and that ruined a lot of my progress. Lack of sleep definitely had impact on my emotional control. This was a good session of finding weaknesses and also strengths.

realizing that a lot of my frustrations and struggles come from impatience. like i want to pass this eval already. I want to get my next payout already. i want to hit 10k this month already. and that has probably hurt me a lot more than anything else. especially mentally. even from following rules, if i don't get closer to my desire outcome, i get anxious and angry. what would be the solution? messages.content_text:
day 2 

today i woke a bit better than usual days, wasnt trying to go back to sleep. took a walk with my dogs, came back made breakfast, took a shower, and then went to trade. today i saw that we was bouncing off a a 1hr gap, so i wanted longs, and pre market structure was bullish, so i wanted longs. market opened, and saw that we formed a 5m RB, and the bullish candle was strong, so i knew we wanted to go longs, i placed my limit on the ce of the 5m, because the RB was to big. a couple min after, it hit my limit. then it went into profit. i didnt totally wanted to go BE yet, so i just put my sl on the recent low on the 1 min that was created when it touch my limit. less risk and makes sense cause there would be no reason to go to the CE again, and if it did touch my sl, it just means that it wants to go more lower. however that didnt happen, it hit my tp. it was a good trade, a win or a loss, it was still a good trade. i just need to focus from now on. this will be routine everyday. if i lose, i continue, if i win, i continue. i dont stop,  will not, until i hit my goal, and even then, no giving up.

july 1 Notes:


My alarms very unfortunately did not ring this morning so I missed the trading day, but it may have been a good one, but it also could have gone poorly all around the 10:00.
,
Price traded lower during the entirety of the overnight session and we got a retracement right off of market open at 9:30. when 10:00 opened the first candle was technically a 5min bearish rb. What makes an rb important though is what it is rejecting from, and we did not tap a pd array or sweep any liquidity. So if you entered off of this first 10:00 candle it would have been an instant loss. Price then traded higher though, swept a 9:00 high, and tapped an hourly fvg, as well as an unmitigated 5min fvg, while making a new 5min rb. The wick was about 30 points, so I would enter off of the ce and take a 100pt tp as there were some 1min equal lows at that level. This would be a winning trade and it either would have been the second trade of the day, or the first.
,
price action was a little slow and choppy today, but still gave this nice setup which I think would be an A or A- because the problem was that es and nq were really uncorrelated: Market pumped at 9:30 open on both assets, but continued to pump much more aggressively on es after 10:00 whereas the nasdaq consolidated more.
,

messages.content_text:
DAY 24  : 4 TRADES 2WINS 1 BE 1 L (EVALS)

TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
So the movement i was looking for yesterday finally happened today. I was right but in the wrong time. we come back down to the OTE level which was 1 HR OB, 5min FVG. I didn't find a breaker i could comfortably take, so i went for RB instead. i referenced the movment from ES compared to NQ as had a good hunch that price would move back to the 5 min RB. Take note that a lot of liquidity was already taken out. I added in my position as i scaled out. To be honest, i should've just kept it static and stop being a bitch.

Second trade, entered off of a pretty strong 5 min RB, hit -4 stdv and touched discount 5/15 min FVG. We were sure to tap and retrace. and from 4HR candle, it's going to be a bearish distribution day. Tapped me in in CE, but i made a half mistake by edging my SL to BE before the high was crossed, but TBH i think powell would have done the same.

Third trade was assuming that we were still bullish because ES still was moving up. It created an SMT, but tbh i should've not longed a bearish SMT. Simple mistake that can be avoided. it was lower risk.

Fourth trade was a silver bullet trade. Saw a breaker aligned with a FVG on the 30 sec, tfa with 5 min. price ran perfectly to TP but i was a bitch and tried to scale out. and hit sell instead of buy to scale out. and freaked out and cut the trade short. What could have been my 1500 day turned to 1000. just put limits in and drag them. safer that way. or just be careful next time. The entry was perfect. 

PSYCHOLOGICAL ANALYSIS
Execution was perfect. Risk management needs to be worked on. I think because of my lack of confidence, i wanted to take my profits as soon as i saw a potential retracement. Which isn't wrong, but not really my style tbh. and pulling stops early, stop being a bitch and hold it. Also i told myself that's it and went back in, lets catch that next time and be more patient. Don't make the same mistake again bro. (edited)
